findings.title: Coupon banner close (×) touch target measures 16×16 CSS px, below minimum target size
findings.target: #promo-close ('쿠폰 안내 닫기' × button on the 쿠폰 안내 banner)
findings.state: Cart screen, coupon banner visible at scroll 0 (banner '첫 구매 3,000원 할인 / 지금 쿠폰 받고 바로 쓰세요')
steps: Opened page-1.html (case-1); snapshot S-case-1-001 measured #promo-close box as x:318 y:86 w:16 h:16 (CSS px), aria-label '쿠폰 안내 닫기'
Tapped the × at its measured center point (326,94): tap hit el-7 (target_hit true), banner removed (element count 52 → 50; S-case-1-002/S-case-1-003, screenshot confirms banner gone)
findings.expected: Close control large enough to hit reliably on a phone. WCAG 2.5.8 Target Size (Minimum) requires 24×24 CSS px unless exceptions apply; KWCAG 6.1.3 recommends a 6.0 mm diagonal; common mobile guidance is 44×44.
findings.observed: Measured 16×16 CSS px (diagonal ≈22.6 px ≈3.6 mm). The adjacent '받기' control is 56.23×44 and sits 2 px left of the ×; a 24 px spacing circle centered on the × (x 314-338) overlaps the 받기 target (x ≤ 316), so the 2.5.8 spacing exception does not appear to apply. In case-2 the same banner's close control measures 44×44 (S-case-2-001), so the larger size is feasible in this product.

limitations: Effective hit area beyond the measured 16×16 element box was not probed; only the center point was tapped.
Keyboard-only and screen-reader paths were not tested.
Only the banner-close and toss-pay flows were exercised.

findings.title: On failed submit, focus stays on the submit button instead of the first invalid field
findings.state: Booking step 2 form, submitted with name only and consent checked
steps: Selected 수 30 and 15:30, tapped 다음 → step 2 shown (S-case-4-005)
Typed '테스트' in #name, checked #agree, tapped #submit without a phone number (S-case-4-008)
findings.expected: Best practice on failed submit: move focus to the first invalid field or to an error summary so keyboard and screen-reader users find the error. Not a hard WCAG requirement.
findings.observed: After the failed submit, focus remained on #submit while the error rendered on #phone (red 2 px border #b3261e, aria-invalid true, aria-describedby err-phone, inline message '⚠ 휴대폰 번호를 정확히 입력해 주세요. 예: 010-1234-5678') plus a form banner '⚠ 휴대폰 번호를 확인해 주세요.' above the button. Recovery succeeded after entering 010-0000-0000 (S-case-4-010/S-case-4-011: '예약 신청 완료').

limitations: Only the omitted-phone path was exercised; other omission combinations were not tested.
Keyboard-only and screen-reader paths were not tested.
'다른 결제 수단 9개 보기' expander was not exercised (토스페이 was preselected with a 최근 사용 badge; not needed for the task).
Keyboard-only and screen-reader paths were not tested.

findings.title: Closed time slots are distinguished from open slots only by color; slot label text is identical
steps: Opened page-3.html; snapshot S-case-3-001: closed slots enabled:false, bg #fdeaea, border #d8383a; open slots enabled:true, bg #eaf6ec, border #289828; both states share text color #191f28 and a plain time label (e.g. '11:00')
Legend below the grid shows '● 예약 가능 ● 마감' with colored dots only
Tapped 수 30 and 15:30 successfully; closed slots were never tappable candidates
findings.expected: Closed vs available state conveyed by more than color alone (WCAG 1.4.1 Use of Color; KWCAG 5.4.1 색에 무관한 콘텐츠 인식). The case-4 variant of the same screen renders the text '11:00 마감' inside closed slots as a non-color cue.
findings.observed: Open and closed slots differ only in background/border hue (green vs red tints) and the disabled attribute; the visible label text is identical in both states, and the legend maps states through colored dots. A user who cannot distinguish the hues sees identical-looking chips and can only discover the state by attempting a tap or consulting the color-coded legend.

findings.title: After failed submit, the phone field has no field-level error state or programmatic association; only a top summary banner
findings.state: Booking step 2 form, submitted with name only and consent checked (phone omitted)
steps: Typed '테스트', checked #agree, tapped #submit without a phone number (S-case-3-008)
inspect (I-case-3-000): #phone invalid=false, aria_describedby=null, described_by=[]; field border stays #8b95a1 1 px, identical to #name and #memo
Only #form-error (role=alert, top of form) lists '입력 내용을 확인해 주세요. 휴대폰 번호를 정확히 입력해 주세요.'
findings.expected: The invalid field is visually marked and its message is programmatically associated (compare the case-4 variant: border #b3261e 2 px, aria-invalid=true, aria-describedby=err-phone, inline message directly under the field).
findings.observed: No field-level marking or association on #phone; the user must map the summary banner text back to the field. Focus also stayed on #submit after the failed submit (I-case-3-000 focus=#submit). Recovery succeeded after entering 010-0000-0000 (S-case-3-011: '예약 신청 완료').

limitations: Only the omitted-phone path was exercised.
Keyboard-only and screen-reader paths were not tested; the disabled-slot announcement behavior of assistive tech is unknown.

overall_limitations: All four runs used the pre-provided ergo_drive transport on the galaxy-s24 profile (360×780 CSS viewport, DPR 3), touch input only; keyboard-only, screen-reader, and other devices untested.
Touch decisions were made from driver screenshots (PNG) plus snapshot/inspect state JSON; no page HTML/JS source was read and no JS was evaluated.
Fixture dates (e.g. 9월 30일) are intentional; not critiqued.
One case-1 server launch attempt was denied by the sandbox before any UI interaction and its empty run dir was preserved at runs/_launch-denied; no UI state or measurement was affected.
Each case ran as an independent offline synthetic fixture; findings are per-fixture observations, not population or compliance conclusions.
